data.title: Firefighters on the offensive in France and Spain
data.description: LEGE-CAP-FERRET, France - Firefighters in France and Spain rushed to contain the worst wildfires in living memory on Tuesday, seizing crucial hours before the arrival of another wave brings scorching temperatures.

data.title: 7.1 earthquake strikes Japan’s Kyushu region
data.description: TOKYO - An earthquake with a ​preliminary magnitude of 7.1 struck Kumamoto prefecture in southern Japan on Tuesday, knocking out power to thousands of homes, stopping rail services and triggering warnings for tsunamis and aftershocks.

data.title: Civilian killings on the rise in Myanmar
data.description: Myanmar’s military has sharply escalated attacks on civilians since a new administration took office in the war-torn country, a conflict monitor said on Monday, even as regional governments ramp up diplomatic engagement.

data.title: Wildlife face ‘catastrophic’ losses in French blazes
data.description: PARIS - Deer trapped by walls of flame, lizards unable to escape the heat, habitats reduced to charred wood and ash: wildlife are paying a steep price as France's forests burn.

data.title: Sudan militia leader ‘unleashes’ fighters after army gains
data.description: EL-OBEID, Sudan - Sudan paramilitary leader Mohamed Hamdan Daglo, whose Rapid Support Forces (RSF) have been accused of genocide, told his fighters Monday to consider themselves “unleashed” in their war against the army.

data.title: Brazil's Amazonia theatres earn World Heritage status
data.description: BRASíLIA - Unesco on Monday added Brazil's Theatro da Paz and Teatro Amazonas to its World Heritage list.

data.title: AI cameras spot suicide attempts in Seoul
data.description: SEOUL - When AI-powered cameras on bridges over Seoul's Han River raise the alarm that someone may be about to jump, acting quickly is vital.

data.title: UN lists South Sudan antelope route as heritage in danger
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - The United Nations has fast-tracked a vast antelope migration path in South Sudan onto its list of World Heritage in Danger, in the young nation's first such listing.

data.title: Sudan RSF leader 'unleashes' fighters after army gains in Kordofan
data.description: EL-OBEID (SUDAN) - Sudan paramilitary leader Mohamed Hamdan Daglo, whose Rapid Support Forces have been accused of genocide, told his fighters Monday to consider themselves "unleashed" in their war against the army.

data.title: UK funeral director faces jail over bodies left 'on racks'
data.description: KINGSTON UPON HULL (UNITED KINGDOM) - A British funeral director faced prison Monday over a scandal that saw bodies left "stored on racks" and uncremated while relatives were handed other people's ashes, sparking calls for better regulation of the industry.

data.title: Brazil's Amazonia theaters earn UNESCO World Heritage status

data.title: Wildlife face 'catastrophic' losses as France's forests burn
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Deer trapped by walls of flame, lizards unable to escape the heat, habitats reduced to charred wood and ash: wildlife are paying a steep price as France's forests burn.

data.title: India activists demand release of detained 'cockroach' protesters
data.description: NEW DELHI - India's youth-led "cockroach" movement, whose nationwide protests forced the resignation of the education minister, urged authorities on Monday to release all detained demonstrators.

data.title: HIV progress in 'real danger' as global funding plummets
data.description: RIO DE JANEIRO (BRAZIL) - The science has never been better, but political will has reached a new low: AIDS experts warned Monday that the fight against HIV was in real danger as funding fell by a fifth last year.

data.title: China charges alleged scam kingpin Chen Zhi with intentional injury
data.description: SHANGHAI — Alleged scam-network mastermind Chen Zhi could face the death penalty, with Chinese prosecutors adding intentional injury to the list of charges against him.

data.title: Heat, overcrowding, pushes Italian prison guard union to sue
data.description: ROME — A prison guard union in Italy's southern Puglia region will ask prosecutors to investigate widespread workplace safety abuses, with temperatures inside overcrowded prisons rising above 50°C, in a case the union says is a first, Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) has learned.

data.title: Spain races to contain blazes before new heatwave
data.description: NAVALUENGA (SPAIN) - Spain has two crucial days in front of it to bring wildfires under control before weather conditions worsen, authorities said Monday, as Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez called on citizens to "exercise extreme caution" ahead of a new heatwave.

data.title: South Africa's Ramaphosa calls for African action on migration
data.description: MIDRAND — South African President Cyril Ramaphosa called on Monday for African countries to work together to manage migration, as his government faces mounting pressure over attacks on foreign nationals.

data.title: Malaysia detains over 100 Rohingya refugees seeking shelter at UNHCR
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR, July 27 (Reuters) - Malaysian authorities detained more than 100 Rohingya Muslim asylum seekers on Monday who had gathered outside the United Nations (UN) refugee agency in Kuala Lumpur, saying they were seeking protection after being evicted from their homes.

data.title: Malaysia PM orders action against Rohingya Muslims gathered in front of UN refugee agency
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR — Malaysian ⁠Prime ⁠Minister Anwar Ibrahim on Monday ​ordered enforcement agencies to take action against a group of Rohingya Muslim ​refugees that had gathered in front ‌of the office of the United Nations (UN) refugee agency in Kuala Lumpur, saying those without proper permits would be detained.

data.title: Infantino slams World Cup critics for 'spreading hate'
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA president Gianni Infantino has hit back at World Cup critics, claiming they were "spreading hate and false rumours" and arguing the tournament delivered "only joy and happiness".

data.title: Indonesia's Prabowo approval rating drops to 51.1%, survey finds
data.description: JAKARTA - The approval ⁠rating ⁠of Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto ​fell to 51.1% in July 2026, a poll showed, with respondents pointing to the ​state of the country's economy more ‌than a year and a half into his term of office.

data.title: Stranded tourists evacuated from China's famed Jiuzhaigou World Heritage site after mudslides, heavy rain
data.description: HONG KONG - China ⁠evacuated ⁠stranded tourists from the Unesco ​World Heritage site of Jiuzhaigou on Monday after mudslides triggered by heavy rain, ​state broadcaster CCTV reported, as authorities issued ‌the highest flash-flood alert for parts of the country in the wake of Typhoon Noul.

data.title: France, Spain race to contain 'monster' fires ahead of new heatwave
data.description: BORDEAUX - Shelters in France and Spain on Monday overflowed with exhausted locals and holidaymakers forced to flee blazes so massive some were forming their own mini weather systems, as authorities warned a new heatwave was set to descend on parts of the region.
